rounds.text: Elin Electronics Ltd is fundamentally mispriced relative to its asset backing, trading at a steep discount with a price-to-book ratio of 0.86x on a book value of ₹ 112 against a share price of ₹ 96.5 [E2], which drops even lower to 0.84x compared to a sector benchmark of 3.33x [E7]. This asset undervaluation occurs while top-line expansion is visibly accelerating, demonstrated by a trailing twelve-month compounded sales growth of 15% [E16], quarterly screen signals noting sales up QoQ [E64], and a multi-year sales uptrend [E65]. Furthermore, the business is actively laying the groundwork for future scale, as evidenced by Capital Work-in-Progress surging by 833.3% to ₹ 28 Cr by March 2026, marking a significant capex build-up phase [E36]. Conceded: compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months stands at -48% [E19] and the stock sits at just 2% of its 52-week range [E5].
